title: Trichology Protocol for Hair Fall & Crown Thinning
content: For excessive shedding and sparse hairlines, trichologists recommend a synergistic 3-step regimen: 1. Morning: Apply Rosemary & Biotin Scalp Density Serum to stimulate microcirculation and deliver copper peptides. 2. Night: Apply Overnight Follicle Cellular Renewal Elixir containing 3% Redensyl to activate stem cells during sleep. 3. Weekly: Exfoliate with Salicylic Acid Scalp Detox Scrub to unclog sebum plugs around hair follicles.

title: Bond Repair Protocol for Bleached & Heat-Damaged Strands
content: To reverse chemical bleach damage and thermal heat brittleness: 1. Wash with Hydrolyzed Keratin & Argan Repair Shampoo to cleanse gently without stripping natural lipids. 2. Treat with Biomimetic Peptide Deep Restorative Mask for 8-10 minutes twice weekly to rebuild broken disulfide keratin bonds. 3. Before blow-drying or heat styling, mist with Thermal Defense Gloss Mist (protects up to 450°F).

title: Scalp Health, Flakes & Seborrheic Itch Protocol
content: To eliminate persistent dandruff flakes and calm inflamed scalp: 1. Use Salicylic Acid & Tea Tree Scalp Detox Scrub 1-2 times per week to chemically dissolve dead keratinocytes and unclog follicle pores. 2. Follow with a gentle sulfate-free cleanser. 3. Avoid heavy occlusive petroleum waxes directly on the scalp which can feed Malassezia yeast.

title: Curly, Coily & Wavy (3A-4C) Moisture & Definition Guide
content: For maximum curl elongation, zero frizz, and 5-day definition: 1. Cleanse with sulfate-free Keratin & Argan Shampoo to preserve natural sebum. 2. Deep condition with Biomimetic Peptide Mask using the 'squish to condish' method. 3. On soaking wet hair, apply Flaxseed & Coconut Moisture Curl Custard in sections to seal hydration and define curl clumps. Air dry or diffuse on low heat.

title: Active Ingredient Science: Rosemary Leaf Oil & Copper Peptides
content: Clinical comparative studies published in peer-reviewed dermatology journals demonstrate that 3% Rosemary Leaf Oil exhibits efficacy comparable to 2% Minoxidil in improving hair count after 6 months, without scalp pruritus or rebound shedding. Copper Tripeptide-1 enlarges follicle size, stimulates collagen production, and enhances vascular endothelial growth factors (VEGF).

title: Active Ingredient Science: Redensyl & Plant Stem Cells
content: Redensyl is a patented galvanic synergy of DHQG (dihydroquercetin-glucoside) and EGCG-glucoside that targets the outer root sheath stem cells (ORSc) in the hair bulge. It reactivation-triggers the cellular switch from the telogen (resting) phase to the anagen (growth) phase, yielding up to 28,000 new hairs over 3 months of consistent night application.

title: FolliCare Multi-Agent Storefront UI Mutation Capabilities
content: The UI Automation Agent executes real-time declarative UI actions on the storefront: 1. SET_THEME: change aesthetic theme ('botanical-emerald', 'rose-luxury', 'lavender-clean', 'amber-noir', 'light-minimal'). 2. SET_BANNER: update promo announcement bar (custom text, discount code, background gradient, timer). 3. UPDATE_HERO: customize campaign headline, subtitle, badge, and CTA. 4. FILTER_PRODUCTS: filter catalog by category, hair concern ('Hair Fall & Thinning', 'Damaged & Dry Hair', 'Dandruff & Oily Scalp', 'Frizz & Heat Protection', 'Curly, Coily & Wavy (3A-4C)', 'Color Care & Blonde Tone'), max_price, or search keyword. 5. ADD_PRODUCT: dynamically ingest and render newly created product card directly into the DOM grid. 6. ADD_TO_CART / APPLY_DISCOUNT: add items to cart with dynamic quantities. 7. LAUNCH_ROUTINE_BUILDER: open interactive diagnostic modal.

title: FolliCare React Component Architecture & JSX Modular Tree
content: The FolliCare frontend is designed as a modular React component tree: 1. <StorefrontContainer>: Root provider orchestrating themes and global agent state. 2. <TopNavigationBar>: Contains theme selector, search bar, active model dropdown, and sliding cart badge counter. 3. <HeroSection>: Campaign headline, trichological value props, and dynamic promotional banner. 4. <CatalogFilterBar>: Pill-based filters for Category, Hair Concern, and Sort order. 5. <ProductGrid>: Responsive grid rendering animated <ProductCard> components with active ingredients badges, clinical badges, price tags, and Add-to-Cart handlers. 6. <HairDiagnosticModal>: Multi-step interactive trichology quiz generating customized routines. 7. <CartDrawer>: Slide-out shopping bag managing quantities, promo discounts, subtotal, and checkout. 8. <FolliCareChatbot>: Docked bottom window with voice speech recognition, live agent spans, and multimodal upload.

title: FolliCare React Custom Hooks: useFolliCareAgent & State Lifecycle
content: React state lifecycle is managed via the custom hook 'useFolliCareAgent()': It exposes: { messages, isListening, isSpeaking, activeTheme, cart, agentTraces, activeMode, sendMessage, startListening, stopListening, switchTheme, executeDynamicAction, toggleMode }. When a user sends a voice or text command in Developer Mode or Customer Mode, useFolliCareAgent dispatches POST /api/chat with { message, input_type, mode, model_name }, receives declarative commands, and synchronizes React state automatically with zero UI flicker.

title: FolliCare CSS Design Tokens, Theme Variables & Glassmorphism
content: All UI elements utilize standardized CSS Custom Properties: --primary-color (emerald #10b981 / rose #f43f5e / lavender #8b5cf6 / amber #f59e0b), --bg-dark (#090d0b, #120b0f, #0d0b14, #0f0d09), --surface-card (rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)), --border-glass (rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2)), --accent-glow (0 8px 32px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.25)), --font-heading ('Playfair Display', serif), --font-sans ('Inter', sans-serif). UI Developer Mode can alter any CSS property dynamically using the SET_CUSTOM_CSS or UPDATE_THEME_TOKENS commands.

title: UI Developer Mode: Arbitrary Dynamic DOM & React Modification Protocol
content: When operating in UI Developer Mode, the Multi-Agent framework handles arbitrary UI restructuring: 1. SET_CUSTOM_CSS: Injects custom CSS rules into document head. 2. INJECT_REACT_COMPONENT: Dynamically mounts interactive custom React/HTML elements (e.g., reviews carousel, live countdown, before/after slider). 3. MODIFY_LAYOUT: Alters grid layout columns, card padding, navbar heights, or banner placements. 4. EXECUTE_DYNAMIC_JS: Runs safe declarative DOM adjustments requested via voice or text.
